entities.summary: José Elías Rauda Gutiérrez O.F.M. is a Salvadoran Roman Catholic bishop, being the bishop of the Diocese of San Vicente since 2009. He was previously the auxiliary bishop of Santa Ana and titular bishop of Foratiana from 2008 to 2009.
